reviews.review: personally enjoy the game a lot. The grind it takes to unlock, level up, and max out your weapons, characters, and other things always keeps me coming back to the game

At roughly 8 hours of playtime i cant really recommend this game. gameplay is fine like its not anything groundbreaking, the gun and mods are a slight mix of destiny and warframe which is fun to play around with but not really worth investing too much time into. the characters are certainly something not that abilities are cool or really doing anything inspired standard 4 skills per character....its just all gooner bait, if its a female character they have "skins" where they are better off just not having clothes on. the amount of clothing options i seen where it was almost just nothing but a strap or the slightest bit cloth covering nothing but jiggle physics is astounding which if thats your thing no judgment from me, just not mine.  but everything i find boring or just unappealing would be fine if i didnt hit the statistical anomaly on almost every single part of character i farmed for. theyll have a loot table and all the drop chances on a little tab before you even do something (which is somehow the best thing ive seen this game do) with even character parts show which almost always 20%. i ran 1 mission about 15 maybe 18 times still didnt get it which it is a looter shooter so thats expected but it just doesnt respect my time. like in destiny/warframe your almost always getting something to help progress yourself but in this you dont really get that sure you might get some other little armor affix or something but the game tells you where the better way to get that affix alone is, so your running a mission with 20% chance of getting the thing you need 15 times and still not getting it all while you hear the exact same conversation within the 30 something odd feet you have to go in the mission which all the objs just turn into kill everyone in this area until the boss spawns. which now that im thinking about it i did do one where i parkoured around grabbing stuff but that was the odd one out of all the things i did farming wise. point being play any other looter shooter and you might have a better time. unless you love jiggle physics then this game might be the one you play
Fun looter shooter that is not too complex and easy to jump in and out of
